preconditions.description: t is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive, representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(n == int(n) and 2 <= n <= 10**6 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: Each test case's n is an integer between 2 and 10^6 inclusive, representing the length of the string s.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n for n, s in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()], [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()]))
preconditions.description: Each string s has exactly n characters, and consists only of 'a', 'b', and 'c'.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout_line) > 0 and (stdout_line == '-1' or (stdout_line == str(int(stdout_line)) and 2 <= int(stdout_line) <= n)) for stdout_line, n in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either '-1' (no valid substring) or a positive integer representing the length of the smallest valid substring (at least 2).

postconditions.expression: all(any((s[l:r+1].count('a') > s[l:r+1].count('b')) and (s[l:r+1].count('a') > s[l:r+1].count('c')) and (r - l + 1 >= 2) for l in range(n) for r in range(l, n)) if stdout_line != '-1' else False for stdout_line, n, s in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()], [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()]))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', there exists at least one substring of length equal to the output where 'a' occurs strictly more times than both 'b' and 'c'.

postconditions.expression: all(not any((s[l:r+1].count('a') > s[l:r+1].count('b')) and (s[l:r+1].count('a') > s[l:r+1].count('c')) and (r - l + 1 >= 2) and (r - l + 1 < int(stdout_line)) for l in range(n) for r in range(l, n)) if stdout_line != '-1' else True for stdout_line, n, s in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()], [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()]))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', it is the length of the smallest valid substring (no smaller valid substring exists).
